full_prompt_en: A square intricately drawn decorative illustration fills a black ground with colorful birds, flowers, leaves and small fruit. A golden-ochre bird occupies the center-right, facing left with an olive-and-cream patterned wing and a long tapered tail. To its left, a pale gray bird with a turquoise wing looks toward it from a lower perch. On the right, a rounded blue-headed bird carries stacked cyan and bright pink bands across the chest. Above them, smaller turquoise and green birds spread their wings among dense leaves. Large pink and apricot flowers open near the upper right and lower left, while a cream-yellow flower anchors the left middle. Tiny berries, buds and narrow stems fill nearly every gap. The shapes overlap without deep perspective, like a lavishly worked printed textile or illuminated page. Every feather, petal and leaf is defined by thin colored lines and repeated interior marks. The black background appears only in small channels between forms, making the palette of teal, coral, mustard, cream and magenta glow. Light is decorative and even rather than directional; pale edges and darker internal marks give volume without cast shadows. The drawing has a crisp, hand-worked surface with subtle grain and extremely controlled pattern density. No text appears. The overall composition is crowded yet balanced, using three larger resting birds as visual anchors amid a continuous rhythm of smaller wings, blossoms and leaves.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形精细描绘的装饰插画在黑底上填满彩鸟、花朵、叶片和小果。金赭色鸟占据中右部，面向左边，翅膀带橄榄与奶油白花纹，尾巴细长收尖。其左下，一只浅灰鸟带绿松石色翅膀，从较低栖处望向它。右边，一只蓝头圆身鸟的胸口叠着青色与鲜粉色带。上方，更小的青蓝和绿鸟在密集叶丛间展开翅膀。大朵粉花与杏色花在右上和左下盛开，一朵奶油黄色花固定左侧中部。细小浆果、花苞和窄茎填满几乎每处空隙。形状彼此重叠，却没有深透视，像丰厚加工的印花织物或彩绘书页。每片羽毛、花瓣和叶子都由细彩线与重复内部纹痕定义。黑底只在形体之间的狭小通道中露出，让青蓝、珊瑚、芥黄、奶油白与洋红发亮。光具有装饰性且均匀，不来自固定方向；浅边与较深内部笔痕提供体积而无投影。描绘清晰、带手工表面和轻微颗粒，纹样密度控制极细。没有文字。整体构图拥挤却均衡，以三只较大停栖鸟作视觉锚点，周围由更小翅膀、花与叶形成连续节奏。
style_prompt_en: An intricate decorative illustration treatment lays finely patterned organic shapes over a near-black ground. Saturated teal, coral pink, mustard gold, mint, cream and magenta repeat in small, balanced clusters rather than broad gradients. Crisp contours enclose forms filled with parallel veins, scalloped arcs, dots and layered line textures. Overlap creates shallow depth, while the dark negative channels make each colored area distinct and luminous. Illumination is even and symbolic; inner marks and pale rims suggest curvature without cast shadows. Large anchor shapes stabilize a densely continuous field of smaller motifs. The composition feels sumptuous, precise and rhythmically alive, with almost every portion of the frame worked by handlike detail.
style_prompt_zh: 精密装饰插画处理把细密花纹的有机形状铺在近黑底上。饱和青蓝、珊瑚粉、芥黄金、薄荷绿、奶油白与洋红在小块均衡簇群中重复，而非形成宽阔渐层。清晰轮廓围住内部带平行纹脉、扇贝弧、点和层叠线肌理的形体。重叠创造浅纵深，深色负空间通道让每处彩色区域独立而发亮。照明均匀且具象征性；内部纹痕与浅色边缘暗示曲面，没有投影。较大锚定形稳定了小型纹样连续密集的场域。构图丰盛、精确且富节律，画面几乎每处都由手工般细节加工。
theme_en: Colorful birds nestled among dense flowers and leaves on a black decorative ground
theme_zh: 黑色装饰底上，彩鸟栖在繁密花叶之间
name: Millie Marotta
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
